page.layout: Running head at top, rotated with the page: "DE HOMINIS LIBERAT." and page number "365" at the top right. Below it, one rotated diagram (braces and outline) occupying the full page from right to left, with the sentence "Est & alia diuisio filiorum Dei." placed after it. Then a second rotated diagram at the left, beneath the caption.

main_text.l: Ex parentibus: qui propriè sunt naturales, iisque communicatur essentia parentum suorum.
Ex parte, vt nobis quibus essentia parentum nostrorum communicatur tantùm ex parte.
Tota, vt Christo, cui secundùm diuinitatem suam communicatur essentia diuina Patris tora.
Conceptionis è Spiritu Sancto, & vnionis cum Logo, vt Christus secundùm humanam naturam.
Conceptionis è Spiritu S. & vnionis cum Logo, vt Christus secundùm humanam naturam.

page.notes: The page is printed rotated 90 degrees clockwise; the transcription follows the diagram's logical structure. The first diagram's bracket groupings (especially the link of "Tota, vt Christo..." to "Nati") are hard to trace and the levels are my best reading. "tora." in the "Tota" line may be a misprint for "tota"; left as printed with no mark. The page number "365" and running head are as printed. "Filiorum Dei" is printed in three stacked lines (Filio- / rum / Dei) in the scan.
